botsquad-paper-handoff02-run.sh.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/botsquad-runtime/node/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
cd /var/tmp/botsquad-late-close-20261014
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,shutil,json
m=dict(x.split(':',1) for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines());a=int(m['MemAvailable'].split()[0]);d=shutil.disk_usage('.').free
assert a>=900000 and d>=15000000000
print(json.dumps({'availableKiB':a,'diskBytes':d}),flush=True)
PY
tar -xzf /var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-delta.tgz
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,json,hashlib
v=json.loads(pathlib.Path('/var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-inputs.json').read_text())
for f in v['files']:
 b=pathlib.Path(f['path']).read_bytes();assert len(b)==f['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==f['sha256'],f['path']
print(json.dumps({'matchedDeltaFiles':len(v['files'])}),flush=True)
PY
timeout 300 node --max-old-space-size=768 node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc > /var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-build.log 2>&1
node scripts/investment-contracts/generate.mjs --check > /var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-contract.log 2>&1
timeout 180 node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap dist/test/investment-paper-handoff.test.js > /var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-unit.log 2>&1
timeout 660 node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='retained recovery closes and publishes a fill' dist/test/observed-late-close.test.js > /var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-flow.log 2>&1
timeout 600 node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=tap dist/test/investment-team.test.js dist/test/investment-loop.test.js dist/test/investment-loop-recovery.test.js dist/test/investment-loop-financial.test.js dist/test/investment-team-risk.test.js > /var/tmp/botsquad-paper-handoff02-focused.log 2>&1
